source_mode.title: Source Mode
source_mode.description: What to scrape: search tweets, profile timeline, followers, following, or user info.
source_mode.sectionDescription: Choose the scraping mode and configure your query.

search_sort.title: Search Sort
search_sort.description: Sort order for search results. Only applies to 'search' mode.

since.title: Since Date
since.description: Start date for tweet search in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required for search mode.

until.title: Until Date
until.description: End date for tweet search in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

max_items.title: Max Items
max_items.description: Maximum number of items (tweets, followers, etc.) to scrape.

search_query.title: Search Query
search_query.description: Free-text search query. Supports Twitter advanced search operators (e.g. 'bitcoin min_faves:20'). Only applies to 'search' mode.
search_query.sectionDescription: Fine-tune your search query using structured filters.

any_words.title: Any of These Words
any_words.description: Match tweets containing ANY of these words (OR logic).

exact_phrases.title: Exact Phrases
exact_phrases.description: Match tweets containing these exact phrases.

exclude_words.title: Exclude Words
exclude_words.description: Exclude tweets containing any of these words.

hashtags_any.title: Hashtags (Any)
hashtags_any.description: Match tweets with ANY of these hashtags. Prefix with # or $ optional.

profile_urls.title: Profile URLs / Usernames
profile_urls.description: Twitter/X profile URLs or usernames. Used for profile_timeline, followers, following, and user_info modes.
profile_urls.sectionDescription: Specify profiles for timeline, followers, following, or user info scraping.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Filter tweets by language code (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr'). Only applies to 'search' mode.
lang.sectionDescription: Filter results by media, verification status, and other quality signals.

verified_only.title: Verified Only
verified_only.description: Only include tweets from verified accounts.

blue_verified_only.title: Blue Verified Only
blue_verified_only.description: Only include tweets from Blue (premium) verified accounts.

cookies.title: Cookies / Auth Token
cookies.description: Twitter/X authentication. Can be: an auth_token string, a JSON object with {"auth_token": "...", "ct0": "..."}, or a JSON array of account objects. Required for most operations.
cookies.sectionDescription: Provide Twitter/X account credentials. At least one auth_token is required.

proxy.title: Proxy URL
proxy.description: HTTP proxy URL for API requests (e.g. 'http://user:pass@host:port'). Optional.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of concurrent account workers. Higher values = faster but more aggressive.
